# 1 Enoch Chapter 53 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 53:1 — "open mouths" vs. "gaping mouths"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "with-open-mouths" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "with open mouths" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "with gaping mouths" | More vivid; "gaping" adds drama |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "With open mouths" (LOGOS). "Gaping" adds an intensity not in the Ge'ez, though the image is appropriate.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 53:1 — "tokens of homage" vs. "tokens of submission"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "tokens-of-homage" | Literal; Ge'ez = tribute/prostration |
| LOGOS | "tokens of homage" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "tokens of submission" | "Submission" captures forced tribute |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Tokens of homage" (LOGOS). "Homage" covers both voluntary and forced tribute. "Submission" implies only forced compliance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 53:6 — "cause the house of his congregation to appear" vs. "bring his holy community into the open"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "cause-the-house of-his-congregation to-appear" | Literal; Ge'ez = to make visible/manifest |
| LOGOS | "cause the house of his congregation to appear" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "bring his holy community into the open" | Paraphrase; adds "holy" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Cause the house of his congregation to appear" (LOGOS). "House of his congregation" is a specific phrase (cf. the "house of the Lord" imagery) that PNEUMA flattens. "Holy" is not in the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
